Audience: every first-time Wisconsin Class D applicant preparing for the vision screening, the highway signs test and the knowledge test, and later booking the skills test.
Why it matters to a first-timer: this chapter lists the four tests and how the two written tests are scored [A01], and what happens on the appointment-only skills test [A02].
Level: procedural recall with a few exact thresholds (question counts, passing percentage, vision standards); low conceptual load.
Prerequisites: none; this is the first chapter of the handbook and frames every later section.
